issue.title: average_price crashes on an empty cart
issue.body: Calling average_price([]) raises ZeroDivisionError. An empty cart should have an average price of 0.

issue.title: clamp does not apply the lower bound
issue.body: clamp(-5, 0, 10) returns -5 but should return 0. Values below the low limit must be raised to it.

issue.title: count_words counts empty strings when there are extra spaces
issue.body: count_words('  one   two  ') returns 7 instead of 2. Words are separated by any amount of whitespace.
